identity.title: CVE-2026-134765
identity.description: Kirby 5.0.0 before 5.6.4 contains a race condition in Kirby\Api\Upload::processChunk() that allows authenticated users with upload permission to bypass SVG sanitization. Attackers can race concurrent chunked uploads sharing a filename to swap a benign SVG with a script-bearing SVG, executing stored cross-site scripting in the site origin.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: REQUIRED

_relevance.reason: Marketing-focused CMS (Kirby) requiring authenticated upload permission, no identity or DPI-sector nexus.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134793
identity.description: Electerm before 5.9.0 on Windows contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute PowerShell code via crafted file or folder names containing Unicode quote characters. Attackers can deliver names containing U+2019 through archives, WSL distributions, or SMB shares, which break out of getFolderSizeWin() and calcLocal() quoting when victims request folder sizes, executing code as the electerm user.

barriers.summary: local, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

cwe_names.CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

_relevance.reason: barrier_gate: attack vector LOCAL, no exploitation signal

identity.title: CVE-2026-134794
identity.description: HedgeDoc before 1.12.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in the POST /history/:noteId endpoint that allows authenticated users to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ as the noteId. Attackers can send a pinned value to /history/__proto__, which historyPost() in lib/history.js assigns onto the prototype, crashing the Node.js process and causing denial of service for all users.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-1321: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')

_relevance.reason: Collaborative note-taking tool requiring authentication, no enterprise identity or DPI-sector footprint.
